name: Parity Functions
definition: For an integer $n\ge1$, let $X=\mathbb F_2^{2n}$, including its zero vector. The **parity-function class** is $$\mathcal P_n=\{h_a:a\in\mathbb F_2^{2n}\},\qquad h_a(x)=a\cdot x=\sum_{i=1}^{2n}a_ix_i\pmod2.$$ Thus there are $4^n$ distinct concepts on $4^n$ domain points. The input dimension is chosen as $2n$ so the Hadamard sign-rank lower bound is the integer $2^n$.
comments: This is the class of all linear Boolean functions on a vector-space domain, not the even-parity class on a linearly sized coordinate domain. Its sign matrix is a Sylvester-Hadamard matrix, up to a global sign. Its Yang dimension is 2n over every coefficient field, and remains at most 2n on every subclass; sign rank is at least 2^n.
